question: What claim is made about the yoginī named by will such that her scope and agency are attributed to the siddhas and to supreme will?
premises: The yoginī named by will is named Icchākhyā.
She is associated with the siddhas.
By supreme will she extends up to Māyā.
inference: The yoginī Icchākhyā, by supreme will and in association with the siddhas, extends up to Māyā.
uncertainties: The precise mode of extension up to Māyā is not specified here.
plain_english: The yoginī named by will, by supreme will, extends up to Māyā through the siddhas.
